fixed_link: ephemeral IPv4 loopback TLS bolt+ssc-style listener; peer parks its receive direction after the pipelined request write; no relay, delayed encrypted-write await, privileged network change, or external endpoint
harness_change_from_TLS_GATE_01: the preceding application result is small enough to complete within the independent 750 ms write timeout on Windows (the gate's 131072-524288-byte preceding results could not complete on the 65536-byte Windows send buffer), and the owned socket's send buffer is shrunk at the armed encrypted stage; a fourth deep-queue profile covers the adapted-WSL2 kernel behavior measured by the raw-socket mechanism probe

profiles.note: deep queue required on adapted WSL2; recorded as preceding-write-did-not-complete on Windows

selection: same ordered profiles per cell per platform; stop the cell after a qualifying result; two repeats of the qualifying profile; stop the platform on a demonstrated defect
